description: This file defines classes for a custom memory pool allocator, including PoolAllocator and Allocation, with support for guard blocks for debugging. It provides efficient allocation of small heap requests and manages internal memory pools.

classes.name: Allocation
classes.description: Represents a memory allocation with optional guard blocks for debugging, tracks size and previous allocation.

classes.name: PoolAllocator
classes.description: Memory pool allocator class that manages multiple pages of memory, supports push/pop for temporary allocations, and optional guard blocks.

methods.name: Allocation::check
methods.description: Checks the integrity of guard blocks around the allocation.

methods.name: Allocation::AllocationSize
methods.description: Calculates total size needed for an allocation including guard blocks and header.

methods.name: Allocation::OffsetAllocation
methods.description: Returns pointer to user data area within the allocated block.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::push
methods.description: Establishes a new memory allocation point.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::pop
methods.description: Frees all memory allocated since the last push.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::allocate
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of specified size.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::fastAllocate
methods.description: Provides a faster allocation path when alignment is 1, bypassing some bookkeeping.

methods.name: PoolAllocator::lock
methods.description: Prevents allocations (used for thread safety or debugging).
